description: Header file defining the interface for IAVBufferHelper class, which provides functions for handling memory buffers, mapping/unmapping memory handles, and copying data in a media buffer context.

classes.name: IAVBufferHelper
classes.description: An interface class providing methods for handling AV memory buffers, including mapping, unmapping, size retrieval, and secure data handling.

methods.name: mapHandle
methods.description: Maps memory from the given handle, returns a pointer to the mapped data, and outputs its size.

methods.name: unmapHandle
methods.description: Unmaps memory from the given handle, returning success status.

methods.name: getAllocationSize
methods.description: Retrieves the size of the memory allocated for the specified handle.

methods.name: bool writeSecureHandle(uint64_t handle,void * data,uint32_t size)
methods.description: Writes data into a secure handle; has a default implementation returning false.

methods.name: bool copySecureHandleWithMap(uint64_t handleTo,uint64_t handleFrom,CopyMap map,uint32_t mapSize)
methods.description: Copies data between secure handles according to specified offsets and sizes; has a default implementation returning false.

ctags.name: copySecureHandleWithMap
ctags.pattern: /^    virtual bool copySecureHandleWithMap(uint64_t handleTo, uint64_t handleFrom, CopyMap map, ui/

ctags.name: writeSecureHandle
ctags.pattern: /^    virtual bool writeSecureHandle(uint64_t handle, void* data, uint32_t size) { return false; }$/
